filters._note: Fast filters: every value is already in the loaded tables. column = the table column they match. Each lives at one level: no tab/section = the whole dashboard (above the tabs), "tab": "<tab id>" = that tab, "section": "<section id>" = that section's header. Make one slow (parameters) only when changing it means querying the source again.

parameters._note: Slow filters: any choice whose data has to be pulled on its own (a snapshot month, a scenario). Changing one in the app re-runs Pipeline/run_all.py after a confirmation; one value for everyone. Fixed list: {label, default, options: [...]}; month ends: {label, type: month_end, default: latest, options: {month_ends: 12}}. See the dashboard skill, references/add-data-and-filters.md.
